execution: Actual newly generated six-season player-game core CSV -> independently generated reviewed analysis-ready full/model CSVs in a private workspace
algorithm_description: Read newly written player-game core and a previously frozen reviewed analysis-ready package in matching record chunks. Require identical immutable player-team-game IDs and exact semantic equivalence for original core fields except four explicitly enriched later. Canonicalize numeric strings only after numeric equivalence within 1e-8. Re-derive reviewed designation categories, onset types, four category flags and three provisional aliases from official report reasons and generated core; copy separately reviewed award/star/Cup/biographical metadata with explicit inherited provenance. Preserve original output ordering and complete schema.
execution_notes: Processed source and reference in sequential bounded row chunks (140,000 + 108,730); generated gzip parts were concatenated as independent valid gzip members. Comparison was on the fully decompressed CSV byte streams. No incomplete partial output was counted as accepted.
